feedback: where a component's failing findings go (the -2-> edge). WHY: a finding that goes nowhere teaches nothing. USERS: the inspectors.
gate: the == compare, in one place. A gate opens when every expected equals its actual. No oracle, ever.
proof_coverage: joins a ticket's falsifier clauses to the proofs that cover them and the seals that ran green. WHY: a falsifier nobody proves is a hypothesis (Law 3). USERS: the tester.
